doc_friction.issue: `claude -p` from a scratch dir with `--setting-sources "" --tools ""` gives a clean fresh-model call; `--bare` fails with an authentication error in cloud sessions. Not documented in .github/prompts/cloud-session.md, and it is useful for any run that needs uncontaminated model samples. Added to cloud-session.md, "Browser and process tools", in this PR.

notes: Generated with Claude Code CLI, default system prompt, no tools, empty working directory, 10 runs per model per prompt.
